text: Transport ministry records show that Halvorsen Mott won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge, according to a tender award notice published Tuesday on the ministry’s procurement portal. The notice said the 18-month project carries an estimated value of 74.6 million dinars and will replace the flood-damaged crossing on the Vey River with a four-lane span designed to carry heavier freight traffic. Deputy infrastructure minister Elina Voss confirmed the award in a signed statement, saying the firm’s proposal scored highest on price, engineering timetable and local sourcing commitments. Work is due to begin in early November, after final environmental clearance and site handover by the Okarra provincial works office.
